purpose: Frozen development regression of Base versus the Wave A 80-step Teacher-SFT checkpoint on the existing 18-task, four-trial protocol.

exclusions.reason: Released training tasks and owner-reviewed Wave A decisions cannot support a post-training improvement claim.

known_limitations: All 18 tasks were used in earlier development evaluations; this is a frozen regression set, not fresh unseen evaluation.
Task IDs and task-definition entity values were checked disjoint from the 80-row Wave A Teacher-SFT pool.
The 80-step checkpoint was selected using the 22-row development validation loss comparison, before this benchmark run.
Checkpoint selection by teacher-forced loss does not establish Agent task success or business improvement.

Development traces cap each agent turn at 1024 generated tokens and each simulation at 60 steps; these limits cover all observed successful 32K development trajectories while terminating runaway loops before they consume the served context window.
Agent is served by local vLLM; user simulator and NL judge use DeepSeek, whose external backend is not controlled by this repository.
The 11 test_clean tasks use the official test split for development regression only and do not support an official leaderboard or business-improvement claim.
Entity isolation covers task-definition text and frozen training group IDs; it is not proof of independence for every latent environment-state feature.
